Family accounts are separately billed. Confirm one thing: may the native client be separate from the provider? If yes, validate the chosen client's configuration; if no, this candidate remains insufficient unless a first-party app is documented.

rows.name: Mifos X
rows.source_text: Mifos X can supply the credit union's core member savings and lending operations, account transfers and integrated accounting through a configurable open-source banking platform. External payment-network connectivity and local reporting requirements still need evaluation; this research did not test a 400–1,000-member installation.
